title_zh: 今年上半年我国黄金产量152.908吨，同比下降14.62%
title_en: China's Gold Output in H1 2026 Reaches 152.908 Tonnes, Down 14.62% Year-on-Year
summary_zh: 据中国黄金协会数据，2026年上半年我国黄金产量为152.908吨，同比下降14.62%。
summary_en: China's gold output in H1 2026 was 152.908 tonnes, down 14.62% year-on-year, according to China Gold Association.
